# OverlayManager

> **File:** `services/ui/OverlayManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

OverlayManager holds the layouts editor's working copy of Overlay.items (the editor is the pinned last page). Edits only affect localViews and the editor's canvas; the real overlay pages and config.json are untouched until saveChanges(). Mirrors BarManager. Also keeps the page's own state, since the page is unloaded whenever the overlay closes: whether it's editing a page, an edge menu or the lock screen (`editTarget`; the menus are EdgeMenuManager's and the lock screen LockManager's), the selected page, and each overlay's room (for the canvas's "fits" line). The selected page's modules are edited through `layout` (GridEditor, which also holds the selected module).

### Properties

- `localViews` (readonly alias)
- `savedViews` (readonly alias)
- `isDirty` (readonly alias)
- `selectedViewIndex` (int)
- `editTarget` (readonly string): What the layouts editor shows: "page" (selectedViewIndex), "menu" (EdgeMenuManager.selectedMenuIndex), "desktop" (DesktopManager's draft), "lockscreen" (LockManager's) or "greeter" (GreeterManager's).
- `lockscreenEditable` (readonly bool): The lock screen's layout shows only with the built-in locker
- `greeterEditable` (readonly bool): The login screen's, only once it's set up
- `layout` (GridEditor)
- `problems` (readonly var): Why the draft can't be saved as is (empty = savable)
- `areas` (readonly var): { screenName: { width, height, unit } }: the room each overlay has for a page and the card size its content lays out at, in layout px (OverlayGrid), as its OverlayPanel reports them

### Functions

- `loadConfig()`: Keeps the selected page where it still exists
- `ensureLoaded()`: Loads the draft unless it holds unsaved edits (the page is rebuilt whenever the overlay reopens)
- `applyChanges()`: Call after mutating localViews in place
- `viewChanged(index)`: Whether a page differs from the saved page at the same position
- `editPage(index)`
- `editMenu(index)`
- `editDesktop()`
- `editLockscreen()`
- `editGreeter()`
- `pageLinkAvailable(link)`: Whether a page link leads anywhere: the page is in the overlay, and what it edits can be edited
- `pageLinkLabel(link)`
- `pageLinkIcon(link)`
- `followPageLink(link)`: Follows a page link from the current page (the navigator offers the way back), showing what it edits first
- `editPages()`: The pages, or the menus, keeping what was selected in each
- `editMenus()`
- `reportArea(screenName, width, height, unit)`
- `clearArea(screenName)`: A screen's overlay is gone (its screen was unplugged)
- `fitOf(view)`: How much each screen's overlay shrinks a Custom page: [{ screen, scale }], 1 where it fits
- `selectedView()`
- `selectView(index)`
- `addView()`: A new Custom page, selected (tool pages are always in config: they're hidden, never added or removed)
- `duplicateView(index)`: Inserts a copy of a Custom page after it and selects it
- `removeView(index)`
- `moveView(from, to)`: The selected page stays selected wherever it ends up
- `updateViewField(index, key, value)`: One of a page's own fields (name, icon, visible), or its double grid ("fineGrid": layout.grid.fine), which rescales the modules' places so they stay put
- `renameView(index, name)`
- `setViewVisible(index, visible)`: Shown in the navigator (true) or hidden; hidden pages keep their place
- `isSaved(view)`: Whether `view` is saved under its page key: bar buttons and keybinds are saved by other editors, so they may only open a saved page
- `addBarButton(barIndex, zone)`: Adds a Button that opens the selected page to bar `barIndex`'s `zone`, in the bar editor's draft (saved from there or with Save all), then opens the bar editor on that bar
- `addKeybind()`: Adds a keybind that opens the selected page, then opens the keybinds page's editor recording its key
- `openedBy(widget)`: What a bar widget opens that this editor edits (the other way round from addBarButton: a Button's page or menu, or a widget's menu popout): { kind: "page" | "menu", index, label }, or null A Button's…
- `editOpenedBy(widget)`: Shows what a bar widget opens in this editor
- `saveChanges()`: Merged onto the latest real config; stays dirty if rejected
- `resetChanges()`
